email.body:
Dear {{ contact.first_name }},

Congratulations! Your final chapter is ready. Our editors have completed their final review, and your chapter is now in its finished form.

View your final chapter PDF here:
{{ contact.anthology_chapter_pdf_url }}

Edit your final chapter in the Google Doc here:
{{ contact.anthology_chapter_doc_url }}

The PDF is yours to view. The Google Doc is the one you edit, and it is the version we use.

If you would like to approve your chapter or request final changes, open the review form here:
https://link.msgsndr.com/widget/form/<form_id>?anthology_id={{ contact.anthology_active_id }}&stage=s8

Warm regards,
The Editors
